exposure: The coordinator had seen design, exclusions and direction only. This implementer read Table 1, Fig. 1 and the Discussion before writing code; no forecast depends on them.

serving_mass_sensitivity.basis: 28 g TREHA served, of which 98-100% trehalose dihydrate; remainder unspecified and not counted
serving_mass_sensitivity.portion_scaling: proportional in glucose grams; the plan declares no exponent
serving_mass_sensitivity.note: Sensitivity on the actual serving only. The forecast assumes complete hydrolysis and absorption, which the two withdrawn participants contradict for at least some people.

primary_ratio_of_means.definition: ratio of arithmetic mean IAUC 0-2 h, Table 1 (590/1709)
primary_ratio_of_means.interval_assumptions: Conditional on approximately normal paired data, SEs as printed SEMs of n = 20, and t(0.975, 19). The paired covariance is not reported, so rho is unknown; the rho = -1 interval contains the others.

decision_boundaries.reading: Johansen beats equality for every ratio in the widest interval. Johansen versus the Holub scalar is not resolved: their midpoint lies inside the rho = 0 and rho = -1 intervals and only drops out if the arms are strongly positively correlated; the paired correlation is unreported.

does_the_paired_test_constrain_rho.reading: Even the largest possible SE of the paired difference (rho = -1) is small enough for p < 0.01, so the reported test carries no information about the covariance.

primary_mean_individual_ratio.definition: mean of individual trehalose/glucose IAUC ratios, Discussion (36%)
primary_mean_individual_ratio.uncertainty: no dispersion reported; no interval can be formed
primary_mean_individual_ratio.relation_to_ratio_of_means: A different estimand from 590/1709. Both are reported and scored separately; neither replaces the other.

figure_vs_table_descriptive.status: APPROXIMATE visual reading; group-mean curve area, a different operator from the tabled mean of individual areas
figure_vs_table_descriptive.reading: The plotted means reproduce the tabled 0-120 areas within reading error. The 0-180 group-curve figure is a descriptive sensitivity only, not an alternative outcome.

unit_reading.reading: A literal hour unit is incompatible with the peak (an 854 uIU/mL mean increment against a 34 uIU/mL peak increment). The minute reading (uIU*min/mL) is therefore used for levels, CONDITIONALLY; it is not printed. Ratios do not depend on it.

lee_cross_cohort_level_challenge.status: challenge only; conditional on the minute reading and on a uIU-to-pmol convention

anchor.status: cross-cohort challenge only; not a frozen comparator
anchor.source: Lee BM, MSc thesis, University of Toronto 1997, Table 3-1 (printed p. 34); values visually confirmed by the coordinator and Sol
anchor.operator: mean participant-positive incremental plasma insulin area 0-120 min
anchor.differences: plasma vs serum; different assay, laboratory and cohort (Toronto vs lean Japanese adults); same 0-120 positive-area operator family

lee_cross_cohort_level_challenge.reading: With factor 6.0, Lee glucose-25 becomes 1,350 against the observed 1,709 (-0.236 log), while the Johansen ratio over-predicts (+0.196 log). Their sum gives a trehalose level of 567 against 590 (-0.040 log): a near-hit made of two opposite misses. With factor 6.945 the anchor miss grows to -0.382, Johansen's level miss becomes -0.186 and the Holub scalar instead lands closest (+0.029). Which forecast appears to hit the level is decided by an unstated unit convention, so level agreement cannot discriminate between the hypotheses. No absolute-level claim follows.

unavailable.excluded_participants_outcomes: not reported; direction of any effect on either ratio unknown
unavailable.dose_series: single matched portion; no dose response inferred

secondary.insulin_index_comparison: Not an insulin index in the Holt sense (isoenergetic portions, reference food, mean of individual ratios). The Discussion 36% is a mean of individual ratios at equal stated mass, the closest available analogue, but at 25 g rather than an isoenergetic portion.
